    mov es, ax
    mov fs, ax
    mov gs, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov esp, 0x90000

boot_drive: db 0

/* Freestanding kernel: VGA text mode driver (80x25 at 0xB8000). */
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned short u16;

#define VGA_MEM   ((volatile u16 *)0xB8000)
#define VGA_COLS  80
#define VGA_ROWS  25
#define ATTR_DEFAULT 0x07
#define ATTR_TITLE   0x1F

static int cur_row, cur_col;

static u16 cell(char c, u8 attr) { return (u16)((attr << 8) | (u8)c); }

static void vga_clear(u8 attr)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < VGA_COLS * VGA_ROWS; i++)
        VGA_MEM[i] = cell(' ', attr);
    cur_row = cur_col = 0;
}

static void vga_scroll(void)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < VGA_COLS * (VGA_ROWS - 1); i++)
        VGA_MEM[i] = VGA_MEM[i + VGA_COLS];
    for (int i = 0; i < VGA_COLS; i++)
        VGA_MEM[VGA_COLS * (VGA_ROWS - 1) + i] = cell(' ', ATTR_DEFAULT);
    cur_row = VGA_ROWS - 1;
}

static void vga_putc(char c, u8 attr)
{
    if (c == '\n') {
        cur_col = 0;
        cur_row++;
    } else {
        VGA_MEM[cur_row * VGA_COLS + cur_col] = cell(c, attr);
        if (++cur_col == VGA_COLS) {
            cur_col = 0;
            cur_row++;
        }
    }
    if (cur_row >= VGA_ROWS)
        vga_scroll();
}

static void vga_puts(const char *s, u8 attr)
{
    while (*s)
        vga_putc(*s++, attr);
}

__attribute__((section(".text.entry"), noreturn))
void kmain(void)
{
    vga_clear(ATTR_DEFAULT);
    vga_puts("MiniOS 0.1 - booted in 32-bit protected mode\n", ATTR_TITLE);
    vga_puts("VGA text output works. Halting.\n", ATTR_DEFAULT);
    for (;;)
        __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}
EOF

cat > tests_os/test_os.py <<'EOF'
import os
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import unittest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BANNER = "MiniOS 0.1"


def make():
    subprocess.run(["make", "-C", ROOT, "os.img"], check=True, capture_output=True)


def read(path):
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, path), "rb") as f:
        return f.read()


class OsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        make()

    def test_boot_sector_signature(self):
        img = read("os.img")
        self.assertGreater(len(img), 512)
        self.assertEqual(img[510:512], b"\x55\xaa")
        self.assertEqual(len(read("build/boot.bin")), 512)

    def test_kernel_is_freestanding(self):
        src = read("os/kernel.c").decode()
        self.assertEqual(re.findall(r"#\s*include\s*[<\"][^>\"]+", src), [])
        mk = read("Makefile").decode()
        self.assertIn("-ffreestanding", mk)
        self.assertIn("-nostdlib", mk)
        out = subprocess.run(["i686-elf-nm", "-u", os.path.join(ROOT, "build/kernel.elf")],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        self.assertEqual(out.strip(), "")

    def test_kernel_uses_vga_buffer(self):
        src = read("os/kernel.c").decode()
        self.assertIn("0xB8000", src)
        self.assertIn("VGA_COLS  80", src)
        self.assertIn("VGA_ROWS  25", src)

    def test_qemu_boot_shows_banner(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            dump = os.path.join(d, "vga.bin")
            p = subprocess.Popen(
                ["qemu-system-i386", "-display", "none", "-serial", "none",
                 "-monitor", "stdio", "-drive",
                 "format=raw,file=" + os.path.join(ROOT, "os.img")],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            try:
                text = ""
                for _ in range(10):
                    time.sleep(1)
                    if os.path.exists(dump):
                        os.remove(dump)
                    p.stdin.write(("pmemsave 0xb8000 4000 %s\n" % dump).encode())
                    p.stdin.flush()
                    time.sleep(0.5)
                    if os.path.exists(dump):
                        data = open(dump, "rb").read()
                        text = data[0::2].decode("latin1")
                        if BANNER in text:
                            break
            finally:
                p.kill()
                p.wait()
            self.assertIn(BANNER, text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
